colors.name: paper
colors.role: background — uncoated riso stock; the page is a printed sheet, never a white screen

colors.name: ink
colors.role: all functional text, registration marks, hairlines — 15.3:1 on paper (AAA)

colors.name: fluo-pink
colors.role: spot color drum 1 — fluorescent pink plate; as a surface carries ink text at 5.4:1 (AA). On paper alone 2.84:1: display/decoration only

colors.name: riso-blue
colors.role: spot color drum 2 — riso blue plate, halftone fields, links, focus ring — paper-on-blue 5.1:1 (AA); as text on paper 3.0:1 so large/display only

colors.name: riso-yellow
colors.role: spot color drum 3 — riso yellow plate, the press-builder layer 3; ink-on-yellow 12.6:1 (AAA); on paper 1.21:1 so decoration/surface only

colors.name: overprint-violet
colors.role: computed — pink×blue multiply overlap where two drums cross; decorative, never text

fonts.role: every Hangul glyph on the page + Korean display — a book publisher sets Korean in a serif first
Latin body & section serif, paired with Noto Serif KR so EN/KR share a serif register; display weight for the wordmark
folios, captions, registration-mark annotations, the press operator's ledger hand

texture: Two SVG filter layers, both static. (1) Paper grain: one full-viewport feTurbulence rect (fractalNoise, baseFrequency 0.9, 2 octaves, seed 11, stitchTiles) through a feColorMatrix that zeroes RGB and scales alpha to ~0.07, overlaid with mix-blend-mode: multiply at opacity 0.5 — sparse dark fiber, never animated. (2) Halftone dots: radial-gradient dot fields (color 38% → transparent 42%) at 11px tile for the spot-color plates, applied as CSS backgrounds on plate elements so a 3-color print reads as dot screens, not flat fills. Overprint logic via mix-blend-mode: multiply wherever two drum colors cross (pink×blue→violet, three-way→near-ink). A subtle misregistration: each plate's offset lerps a few px toward the pointer under .riso-js, dead under reduced motion.

motion.name: press-reveal
motion.value: 0ms in / 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) out — clip-path polygon wipes open from a hard press cut, like a page coming off the drum

motion.name: scrub-lerp
motion.value: 0.12 per 60fps-normalized frame — --riso-press chases scroll progress so the overprint build is scrubbable without jitter

motion.name: layer-rise
motion.value: opacity 0→1 and translateY(18px→0) at 520ms ease-out, staggered 90ms — each drum drops onto the sheet as its phase opens

motion.name: misreg-drift
motion.value: plate offset lerps toward pointer ×0.018, capped ±4px, frame-normalized 0.85 — the print breathes under the hand

motion.name: link-press
motion.value: 0ms in / 120ms ease-out out, translate 1px — a stamp-tap, not a hover lift
